reason: Immediate admission acquired idle windows, but two manually launched foreign jobs arrived after 5 to 15 seconds. PGR yielded safely before the existing five-prompt atomic-save boundary, so valid generation work in those short slices was discarded.

change.details: Pass --save-every 1 to the resumable bank builder instead of using its default five-item cadence.

invariants: Each item still uses the same prompt-derived panel seeds.
Atomic replacement still exposes only complete JSON.
Final evidence is still attached only after all 1000 raw items exist.
The change cannot alter a completion, reward, training example, or statistical result.
scope: Pre-outcome durability correction for highly preemptible bank generation.
